name: Do I need to paint or stain the trim before or after installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to paint or stain the trim before or after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can paint or stain trim either before or after installation, each with its own advantages. Pre-finishing trim before it's installed allows for a smoother, more consistent finish without concern for paint drips on walls or floors, and often saves time on-site. However, minor touch-ups will be necessary after installation to cover nail holes and caulk lines. Finishing after installation ensures a perfect match with existing wall colors and allows for seamless filling of gaps, but requires careful masking to protect surrounding surfaces. We typically recommend pre-finishing for efficiency and a cleaner result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pre-finishing trim before installation offers a cleaner finish and saves time, though touch-ups are needed. Finishing after allows for perfect color matching but requires careful masking.
